drawings.title: Site plan
drawings.detail: Where applicable it shows: the site's dimensions and boundaries, the dimensioned position of any building line, the position and width of any servitude or right of way, the site's registered number, true north (contours or corner levels if the authority asks), the street name, municipal services and connection points, existing drains and stormwater channels, the proposed building, existing buildings, buildings to be demolished, and the points of access from the street.

drawings.title: Layout drawings: plans
drawings.detail: Plans of each level, with the occupancy classification, showing foundations, floors, walls, windows and ventilation, doors, stairs, sanitary fixtures, and the intended use and dimensions of rooms.

drawings.title: Layout drawings: sections
drawings.detail: As many sections as are needed to show the building, with vertical dimensions, roofs and damp-proofing.

drawings.title: Layout drawings: elevations
drawings.detail: As many elevations as are needed to show the building.

drawings.title: Fire installation drawing
drawings.detail: The fire installation, where the building has one.

drawings.title: Drainage installation drawing
drawings.detail: The drainage installation.

drawings.title: General structural arrangements
drawings.detail: Where the local authority requires them.

drawings.title: General arrangement of artificial ventilation
drawings.detail: Where the local authority requires it.

drawings.title: Fire protection plan
drawings.detail: Where the local authority requires one.

drawings.title: Fenestration and insulation details for energy usage
drawings.detail: Where provided, details of fenestration and insulation needed to satisfy the energy usage requirements of regulation XA, shown with the layout drawings.

documents.title: Application form with the professional's declaration
documents.detail: The application form, with the declaration by a registered professional in Form 1 of SANS 10400-A saying how the functional regulations will be satisfied.

documents.title: Particulars of a building to be demolished
documents.detail: Particulars of any existing building to be demolished and the method of demolition.

documents.title: Certificates, including any Agrement certificate
documents.detail: Any certificate the regulations call for, where the local authority requires it.

documents.title: Particulars under other legislation, by-laws or SANS 10400
documents.detail: Whatever else applicable legislation, the municipality's by-laws or a part of SANS 10400 requires.

steps.title: Check the property and prerequisite approvals
steps.handIn: Nothing yet: the property is registered and any departure or environmental approval is in hand
steps.detail: The page gives departure approval and environmental authorisation as examples.

steps.title: Submit the building plan and pay
steps.who: Applicant (an owner, or an architect or draughtsperson with the A1(9) agreement)
steps.handIn: The building plan application with the documents that apply, and the scrutiny fee
steps.detail: Fees follow the City's official tariffs, are paid in full on submission and are not refundable if the application is refused. The tariff amounts are in a PDF that was not read.
steps.clause: Step 4 and the application documents page

steps.title: Circulation for comment, then approval
steps.handIn: Corrections, if the plan is sent back for amendment
steps.detail: The plan is circulated to the relevant officials once paid. Work may begin only after approval, with a notice of intention to commence work.

time.text: 30 days for an area under 500 m2 and 60 days for an area over 500 m2, if the plan complies with all requirements

steps.title: Inspections and occupancy
steps.handIn: Requests for the three inspections (commence or trench, sewer, completion), then an application for an occupancy certificate
steps.detail: The occupancy certificate is applied for before the building is occupied.

time.text: Occupancy certificate within 14 days of the request; inspection requests two days before the inspection

format.fileNaming: Under 50 characters, with no permit numbers, addresses or identifiers; calculation packets named Supplemental or Replacement.

copies.text: One set online; four sets if submitted in person. One set is stamped and returned for the job site.

format.stampSpace: Leave room for the City stamp in the top-right or bottom-right corner of each drawing.
format.note: Drawings in one PDF; application, calculations and other documents as separate PDFs. Disable font embedding; scans at 150 dpi; no digitally signed or permission-protected PDFs.

drawings.title: Site plan
drawings.detail: The entire lot at a scale of at least 1 inch = 10 feet, showing where the building sits relative to the property lines and other buildings.

scale.text: at least 1 in = 10 ft (1:120 or larger)

drawings.title: Floor plans
drawings.detail: One for each level where work occurs, existing and proposed, at 1/4 inch = 1 foot: all walls, room sizes and uses, a north arrow, windows with size and type, stairs and smoke detectors; bearing walls, headers and beams here or on framing plans.

drawings.title: Roof plan
drawings.detail: A roof plan.

drawings.title: Foundation plan
drawings.detail: For new buildings and additions: layout, dimensions and details of slabs, footings and reinforcing steel, concrete strength, crawl space access and foundation vents.

drawings.title: Section drawings
drawings.detail: Full sections usually at least 1/4 inch = 1 foot; wall sections and details at least 1/2 inch = 1 foot. Footings, foundation wall height, member sizes and spacing, coverings, insulation, ceiling heights; stair details for new or changed stairs.

scale.text: full sections at least 1/4 in = 1 ft (1:48 or larger); wall sections and details at least 1/2 in = 1 ft (1:24)

drawings.title: Building elevation drawings
drawings.detail: For any exterior change, normally at 1/4 inch = 1 foot: ground level and slope at the building, windows and doors, siding and roofing, guardrails.

drawings.title: Framing plans and structural details
drawings.detail: Separate framing plans where load-bearing members are not on the floor plans; structural sections or details for more complex work.

documents.detail: The completed application form; uploaded as its own PDF, not inside the drawing set.

items.title: Dimensions govern
items.text: Do not scale the drawings. Written dimensions govern. Verify all dimensions on site before work starts and report differences to the designer.

items.title: Codes in force
items.text: All work is to follow the codes and rules in force at the place of the building and the requirements of the approving authority.

items.title: Coordination
items.text: The contractor coordinates the trades and checks these drawings against the engineers' drawings before ordering.

items.title: Fire-rated penetrations
items.text: Seal every penetration of a fire-rated wall or floor with a system suited to that rating.

items.title: Finishes
items.text: Finishes are shown for design intent; confirm selections with the owner before ordering.

items.title: Structure by the engineer
items.text: Structural members are sized by the engineer's drawings; this sheet shows layout only.

items.title: Electrical layout
items.text: Outlet and light positions are indicative; the electrical contractor lays out circuits to the applicable code.

items.title: Testing
items.text: Pressure-test drainage and supply pipework and keep the test record for the inspector.
